claims: Hubert Davis is the head men's basketball coach at the University of North Carolina.
Hubert Davis has been the head men's basketball coach at the University of North Carolina since April 2021.
Hubert Davis was a UNC player from 1988 to 1992.
Hubert Davis led the UNC men's basketball team to the 2022 NCAA Championship game in his first season.
Courtney Banghart is the head coach of the UNC women's basketball team.
Hubert Davis played under Dean Smith at UNC.
Hubert Davis served as an assistant coach under Roy Williams for nine seasons.
Hubert Davis led the Tar Heels to the National Championship game in 2022.
Jeff Lebo, Sean May, and Brad Frederick assist Hubert Davis.
